content.comment_body: Good afternoon, I just registered and would like to know if I can download the [product_name] software today, even if it is not the latest version.

Hello [user_name], and welcome to the forum. Please note that this is an English-speaking forum, so kindly write your future posts in English. To answer your question: You can download the upgrade to the current [version_no]. This upgrade is available only if you already have an installed licensed version. Please be aware that the download is restricted due to export regulations and requires extended registration. Download links for the current [product_name] software and firmware are available with proper access.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants quick access to download a [company_name] software product upon registration, unsure about which versions are available. Responses clarify that only upgrades can be downloaded after confirming license ownership, and additional requirements such as export restrictions and extended registration may delay access. These factors limit immediate product availability for new users.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to download the software right after registering, regardless of whether it is the latest release.
